close_reason: Production readiness achieved: all P0/P1/P2 issues resolved across 2 review rounds. Crates published to crates.io.
description:
Top-level epic for all remaining work to bring the jmap-* crate family
(jmap-types, jmap-server, jmap-mail-*, jmap-chat-*) to production quality.

Covers correctness fixes, API completeness, and architectural work identified
during the cross-crate review (JMAP-4ii, JMAP-fr0, JMAP-ci3, JMAP-287).
notes: Review converged after 2 rounds. Round 1 (JMAP-4ii/63k): fixed SetError consolidation, ClosureHandler, handle_get properties, *changes delegation, Chat/set dedup, Space/join TOCTOU. Round 2 (JMAP-avb): fixed invite-uses rollback on race loss (avb.1), case-insensitive direct kind check (avb.2), dedup removes own entry by joinedAt not first occurrence (avb.4), clarified BackendCallFn doc (avb.3). SEC7 said 'running out of real complaints' after round 2. P0=P1=P2=0.
title: jmap-* crate family: production readiness
